paras: Application: Nissan 370Z (Z34) and Infiniti G37 – VQ37VHR Part Type: Dual Fluid Lock catch can kit Part Number: 20-0525-FL

A catch can collects oil and water vapour from the crankcase gases before they reach the intake, reducing build-up in the intake tract, intercooler, throttle body and manifold. Radium notes this can help effective octane, performance and hydrocarbon emissions, and because the system is closed it also keeps oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: Fluid Lock: Patented design prevents overfilling and retains collected fluid
Retains OEM PCV Function: Cans run inline with the twin valve cover PCV valves
10AN ORB Ports: Inlet and outlet, with a 4AN ORB drain port
Two-Step Baffling: Oil separation with integrated condenser
O-Ring Sealed Dipstick: Easy fluid level checks
Direct Fit: Strut tower mounting, no drilling required
